strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Turns M9.5 selected-index reads into usable task prompt context while preserving index query, snapshot, path-fingerprint, and content-hash provenance.
Consumes bounded content produced by the existing controlled selected-read tool without introducing arbitrary workspace reads, batch reads, or new execution surfaces.
Requires the stored task mode to allow both ReadWorkspace and IndexCodebase before selected content can be materialized into a task prompt.
Records CodebaseIndexPromptContextMaterialized as summary-only task-run evidence with ids, fingerprints, byte counts, content hash status, and redacted prompt-preview status.
Lets unattended callers proceed from build/query/selected-read to an explicit task.run that uses selected context, without caller-side prompt assembly or ledger scraping.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances codebase_indexing directly, with supporting progress for runtime_permission_enforcement, context_management, persistent_structured_ledger, and headless_autonomous_development.
answers.new_capability: Brownie can now accept one prior CodebaseIndexSelectionReadResult on the existing task.run request, validate it against summary-only selected-read ledger evidence, and materialize the selected file content into the prompt under Rust runtime control.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M9.5 returned bounded selected content to the caller, but task.run ignored it. A caller still had to assemble prompt context externally, losing runtime permission checks, event ordering, preview redaction, and replay-safe evidence.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Headless callers would have index-guided content but no runtime-owned way to use it in agent execution. Codebase indexing would remain an out-of-band read helper rather than a prompt-context capability.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M9.3 filtered ignored/sensitive files, M9.4 created metadata-only selections, and M9.5 executed one selected read. M9.6 is the first phase that uses selected-read content inside task.run prompt materialization.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The phase extends the existing task.run params with optional selected_index_context and does not add a JSON-RPC method.
answers.no_new_summary: No. One bounded task-run result summary and one summary-only task ledger event are required so headless callers can confirm the selected context was materialized without exposing raw file content.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The Rust runtime now validates selected_index_context before TaskRunning, rejects missing/stale/tampered selected-read evidence, requires ReadWorkspace and IndexCodebase on the stored task mode, appends CodebaseIndexPromptContextMaterialized, feeds raw selected content only to in-memory PromptBuilder, redacts PromptBuilt previews, and returns a bounded selected_index_prompt_context summary.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A headless caller can run build -> query -> selected read -> task.run and know the selected context was accepted, materialized, and bounded without constructing prompts or reading raw ledgers externally.
answers.milestone_progress: M9 moves from index-backed selected reads to actual task execution context, closing the gap between codebase indexing and agent-loop prompt construction.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M9.6 updates the deterministic current phase manifest and archives the M9.6 value gate. Review must confirm this is task.run prompt-context materialization from a prior selected-read result, not a new wrapper, report, preview, or unvalidated prompt injection surface.

exit_criteria: No new JSON-RPC method is added; selected context is accepted only as an optional task.run parameter

selected_index_context rejects unknown fields, malformed ids or fingerprints, unsafe paths, protected paths, unsupported file kinds, truncation, stale event kinds, stale next_action, unbounded content, byte-count mismatch, hash mismatch, missing source event, and mismatched selected-read ledger payload
The runtime validates selected_index_context before TaskRunning, AgentLoopStarted, PromptBuilt, or CodebaseIndexPromptContextMaterialized can be appended
The stored task mode must allow both ReadWorkspace and IndexCodebase before selected content is materialized

Successful materialization appends exactly one summary-only CodebaseIndexPromptContextMaterialized task ledger event with no raw selected path, raw file content, snippets, diffs, stdout/stderr, environment values, commands, prompts, provider responses, absolute paths, canonical paths, or raw request bodies
PromptBuilder includes the selected file content only in the in-memory Selected Index Context section used for the LLM request
PromptBuilt and SecondPassPromptBuilt payloads redact prompt previews when selected index context is present

TaskRunResult returns bounded selected_index_prompt_context metadata with source event id/kind, ids, fingerprints, byte counts, content hash, redaction status, and next_action, without raw path or content

VSIX validators accept task.run params with selected_index_context and accept selected_index_prompt_context summaries while rejecting raw fields, stale actions, invalid fingerprints, unsafe selected-read content, and byte mismatches
No report, digest, history, readiness wrapper, batch read, chunking, embeddings, Qdrant writes, shell/git/network/service execution, or workspace mutation is added
